title: Sound check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test tone for core-a4 0.5's mod parameters on the Analog Four MKII, so they can be heard: two lockable mod parameters of the synth tracks, LVL (the tone's level, 0..127, 0 silent) and PIT (its pitch, 0..48 semitones above A2), on a SOUND CHECK page behind the AMP key. Every audio block it reads both on each synth voice with core_param_values_voice, so their p-locks, Param Slide, routes, macros and LFO and envelope Dests move the tone as stock's own parameters move a voice, and adds each voice's sine to the effects' return (the DAC words that carry the delay, chorus and reverb back to the outputs). LVL also has a CC.
